name: @pipeworx/mcp-china-recalls

tools.name: china_search_recalls
tools.description: Search product recall announcements from the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), China: about 1,400 announcements since 2018, newest first. Mostly motor vehicles and motorcycles, plus some consumer goods (power banks, vacuum flasks). Filter by title text (Chinese company or product, some English brands), inferred category, and date range. Returns id, title, date and category; pass an id to china_get_recall for the full notice.

query.description: Text in the announcement title, e.g. 特斯拉, 充电宝, 小米, or tesla / power bank.

category.description: Inferred from the title. Default all.

offset.description: Skip this many matches, for paging.

tools.name: china_get_recall
tools.description: One SAMR recall announcement in full: recalling company, units affected, production window, defect and remedy text, issuing unit, publication time and attachments (e.g. the recall plan PDF). Takes the id returned by china_search_recalls. Text is in Chinese.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-china-recalls forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the china-recalls pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
